thought.text: Codex butuh API `responses` yang streamingnya tidak cocok. Saya pakai **opencode** (chat completions, terbukti jalan).

reasoning_content:
Streaming issue: Codex uses SSE streaming with responses API; obscurify's /v1/responses may not support streaming properly ("stream closed before response.completed").

Options:
1. Try a different model on obscurify (maybe gateway supports streaming for some).
2. Test /v1/responses with stream directly to see.
3. Or use a different harness: opencode (supports OpenAI chat completions and custom providers). opencode is in recorded list. Let me install opencode and use chat API.

opencode install: `npm i -g opencode-ai` or `curl -fsSL https://opencode.ai/install | bash`. Local npm: npm i opencode-ai --prefix.

opencode config supports custom provider with baseURL + apiKey, npm @ai-sdk/openai-compatible.

Let me test obscurify /v1/responses streaming first quickly, then decide.

Actually simpler: test whether responses endpoint works non-streaming via curl. If streaming is the issue, maybe Codex has a flag? Not really.

Let me try opencode — it's designed for arbitrary providers via models.dev.

Plan: install opencode locally, configure provider:
~/.config/opencode/opencode.json:
{
  "$schema": "https://opencode.ai/config.json",
  "provider": {
    "obscurify": {
      "npm": "@ai-sdk/openai-compatible",
      "name": "obscurify",
      "options": { "baseURL": "https://obscurify.ai/v1", "apiKey": "{env:OBSCURIFY_API_KEY}" },
      "models": { "deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017-uncensored": { "name": "DeepSeek V4.1 Flash" } }
    }
  },
  "model": "obscurify/deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017-uncensored"
}

Then `opencode run "..."` headless.

Let me test responses streaming first (fast) — if streaming works, codex may work with a different model. Let me just try opencode; it uses chat completions which is proven working.

Install opencode.
